name: bash-it

scripts.checksum_source: locally-pinned upstream script at fixed commit

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum

smoke: export BASH_IT="$OFFLINE_PREFIX"; source "$BASH_IT/bash_it.sh"; type bash-it >/dev/null || exit 1; bash-it enable alias general || exit 1; test -e "$BASH_IT/enabled/750---general.aliases.bash" || exit 1; bash-it show aliases > "$HOME/bash-it-aliases"; grep -q general "$HOME/bash-it-aliases"
notes: Preserves official installer default profile enabling. Uses --silent --no-modify-config so shell startup files remain a user opt-in; test sources Bash-it and enables the general alias collection.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.
